title: Discord’s age verification era is upon us, despite community backlash
summary: Discord is implementing age verification despite user opposition, with the company claiming 90% of users will not be affected by the requirement.
content: According to Discord, 90% of users will not have to verify their age.

zh.title: Discord的年龄验证时代来临，尽管社区反对
zh.summary: Discord正在实施年龄验证，尽管用户反对，但公司声称90%的用户不会受到该要求的影响。

title: OpenAI wants to consult elite mathematicians about how to not fumble again
summary: OpenAI announced an independent panel of mathematicians to advise on how AI companies handle mathematical research and present results, following controversies over the company's recent research announcements.
content:
After turning a string of spectacular mathematical results into a reputational crisis, OpenAI is consulting human mathematicians to help it figure out a less disastrous path forward.
On Monday, the company announced a new independent panel of mathematicians tasked with advising it and other AI companies on their interactions with mathematical research and the wider mathematics community, including how new results are presented and released. Its abrupt arrival caught many mathematicians by surprise. Researchers told The Verge the group is a good first step, but many said they were left with basic questions about what it will actually do, how …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: OpenAI想咨询精英数学家关于如何避免再次失手
zh.summary: OpenAI宣布成立一个独立的数学家委员会，就AI公司如何处理数学研究和呈现结果提供建议，这是在公司最近的研究公告引发争议之后。
